sloka: योनि देशात् च यवनः शकृ देशात् शकाः तथा ।रोम कूपेषु म्लेच्छाः च हारीताः स किरातकाः ॥१-५५-३॥
transliteration: yoni deśāt ca yavanaḥ śakṛ deśāt śakāḥ tathā ।roma kūpeṣu mlecchāḥ ca hārītāḥ sa kirātakāḥ ॥1-55-3॥

translations.english: "From her lowing Kambhojas bright like the Sun, from the udder Paplavas, weapons in hand, from the vagina Yavanas, from the anus Sakas, from the roots of the hair Mlecchas along with Kiratas and Haritas were born.
translations.hindi: जब बुद्धिमान्‌ विश्वामित्र जी आसन पर बैठ गये, तब वसिष्ठ, जी ने फल मूल, जो वहाँ उस समय मौजूद थे, बिश्वा मित्र के लिए दिये
